verdict.rationale: Deel offers founders O-1A services, a free eligibility check delivered within 48 hours with document requirements and personalized advice, and says it frames career achievements to meet O-1 criteria. That is a pre-filing assessment of the product's own, but nothing documents a structured, criterion-by-criterion evaluation of extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS O-1A criteria. Missing for 10: documented structured O-1A criteria mapping or scoring methodology, a sample assessment deliverable, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the assessment's depth.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a structured O-1A qualification assessment — the provider documents how it evaluates my extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS criteria before anything is filed
